countries.label: Countries
countries.description: The countries whose Radioplayer stations the search finds. Until you pick, the country of the server (its time zone, else the language of Music Assistant), when Radioplayer runs there. A station found by search plays from the stream that Radioplayer lists for it. Browse > All stations lists every country, these first.

stations.label: Own stations
stations.description: Optional, for a station the search doesn't find or that should play another stream. One station per line: name | stream URL | Radioplayer id, with an optional | logo URL at the end. The Radioplayer id is the country code and the station id, such as 056/5067. The README explains how to find it.

manifest.name: Radioplayer
manifest.description: Radio stations from Radioplayer, found by search or listed by you, showing the artist, title and cover of what plays now from the public Radioplayer feed.
